messages:
zoe: During today's onboarding smoke test we saw sporadic 429s from the JS quickstart. Console quota looks normal so suspect client-side burst pattern.
ben: can you share the quickstart client snippet?
zoe: posted minimal example: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxInflightRequests: 14,
  prefetchPages: 3,
  pageSize: 48,
  retry: { maxRetries: 2, jitter: false }
});
```
aline: 14 + 3 prefetch = up to 17 concurrent outbound calls per session. small accounts will see short token QPS spikes.
noah: interestingly our go quickstart defaults to 6 inflight. parity gap again.
ben: short-term mitigation: change quickstart to conservative defaults (maxInflightRequests: 6, prefetchPages: 0) and add a client-side smoothing helper.
zoe: i'll PR that. also adding a tiny console log hook emitting current inflight count so devs notice bursts locally.
aline: please include a tiny leaky-bucket wrapper in the sample repo; 6 lines is all you need.
noah: ops suggestion: add an X-Client-Burst header so logs can be correlated with onboarding runs.
sdk-bot: created issue #1250: "quickstart: smooth client defaults, add inflight telemetry and leaky-bucket helper"
ops-bot: support can warm accounts with temporary burst allowance but prefer fixing defaults to avoid tail costs.
ben: longer-term: unify SDK defaults across languages and add an explicit throughputMode option: `'throughputMode': 'smooth' | 'burst'`. default should be smooth.
aline: and add migration docs + changelog note so users aren't surprised by default changes.
zoe: will push patch and update README troubleshooting blurb: "Short 429s during onboarding? Lower maxInflightRequests/prefetchPages, enable jittered backoff, emit inflight metric."
noah: thanks, this should cut support noise. :rocket:
